test_title: PYST 09: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 06 Feb, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence and rectify it. If no correction is needed, select 'No correction required'.

They __are launching__ the new product last month.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence refers to an event that took place in the **past**, as indicated by the time phrase "**last month**".
 
• Therefore, the verb should be in the **simple past tense** to match the time reference.
 
• "**Launched**" is the correct simple past tense form of the verb "launch".
 
• The original verb phrase "**are launching**" is in the present continuous tense, which is incorrect for describing a completed action in the past.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"They **launched**__ the new product last month."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "was launching"** – Incorrect tense and subject-verb agreement error with "they".
 
• **Option 2: "did launched"** – Incorrect structure; "did" should be followed by the base form "launch".
